description:
I'm an IT student interested in web development, technology, and space exploration. I'm participating in NASA Space Apps Challenge 2026 with my project Sol One, an interactive lunar mission simulator for children.

I enjoy learning new skills, building creative projects, and solving problems. I'm passionate about turning ideas into reality through technology.

I'm currently participating solo and would love to connect with people interested in web development, UI/UX design, game development.
